{{Top|leg}}
'''Carahide''' was a form of [[Chitin/Legends|chitin]] that made up the scales of members of the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] species.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> It could deflect a slashing or stabbing attack, and could even deflect a glancing [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] hit.
